claims: The owner explicitly requested building the latest WellSpent version with all changes made today and submitting it to the App Store.
That request authorizes repository updates required for the release candidate, signing and upload, and submission of the resulting build for App Review.
The request does not authorize automatic public release after approval, tester invitations, legal agreement acceptance or destructive device actions.
limitations: Manual release remains required after App Review approval.
This authority receipt records the owner's request; it does not itself prove upload, processing or submission.

authorityReference.reference: Great. Build the latest version of the app with all the changes we made today incorporated and submit it to the app store
